contentPattern.structure: optional heading (e.g. 'Follow Us') + a list of social icon links
contentPattern.note: Reusable standalone 'Follow Us' row. Optional first text-only row becomes the heading; remaining links (each optionally wrapping an icon) render as flush light-grey icon boxes with dark glyphs, matching the footer social cluster. Bare links with no icon fall back to a text glyph derived from the network (Facebook/Twitter/Instagram/YouTube/LinkedIn/...).

suitableFor: standalone 'Follow Us' / social row in a section, sidebar, or article footer
any place needing a reusable row of social-network icon links
notSuitableFor: per-person social links inside a profile card (already handled inline by contributors / article-author)
generic nav or CTA link lists (use default content / buttons)

socialLinks.reason: This IS the standalone reusable social block. The footer, article-author and contributors keep their existing inline social handling to avoid regressing verified blocks; they can be refactored to reuse this block later if desired.
socialLinks.recommendation: Use for new standalone social clusters; do not refactor working inline usages in this phase.

relatedBlocks.footer: Footer has an equivalent inline social cluster (.footer-social) with the same 48px light-box visual — this block mirrors that look as a reusable unit.
relatedBlocks.article-author: Decorates per-author social links inline; not reusable standalone.
relatedBlocks.contributors: Decorates per-person social links inline within each profile card.

usage.note: New reusable block. Available for authoring; no page wired yet (existing social usages remain inline).
